test_DummyInstance_mutable_fields: test the DummyInstance class to verify mutable fields can be reassigned after object creation
test_DummyInstance_immutable_fields: test the DummyInstance class to verify immutable fields raise InstanceFrozenFieldError on reassignment
test_FieldMutation_generic_dataclass: test the FieldMutation generic dataclass to track old and new values for any field type
test_immutable_reference_type_mutation: test that immutable reference type fields like lists can still be mutated in place via append
test_immutable_non_init_field: test that immutable fields with init=False raise AttributeError before first assignment then InstanceFrozenFieldError after
